interfaces.conclusion: The canonical differential for an immersion is an epimorphism of module sheaves.

interfaces.conclusion: The kernel of a sheaf epimorphism between finite locally free sheaves of ranks d+c and d is finite locally free of rank c.
interfaces.hypothesis_review: This is the constant-rank form of exactness and rank additivity. Scheme stalks meet the locally ringed and nonzero-stalk hypotheses. Arbitrary sheaves E and F carry actual local free-cover witnesses.

The original proof specializes only after supplying smooth cotangent ranks and pullback preservation.
